summary: AccumulatorResult extends RuleResult with accumulator-specific accessors: best_combination, accumulated(name), provenance (prime products), depths (combination level).
lifecycle_notes: best_combination delegates to the current RuleResult.best_match, which selects the minimum retained __rank rather than assuming the first stored row is best.
The constructor forwards only dataframe and active_dimensions to RuleResult; it does not preserve the filter result's explicit selection_info.
documentation_hooks: Separate accumulator accessors from inherited filtering and selection methods; do not imply that wrapping a filter result preserves all of its operational metadata.

evidence.detail: AccumulatorResult.__init__ calls RuleResult without selection_info; best_combination delegates to best_match; accumulated, provenance and depths project named result columns.
